overview.description: The NYLIM Candriam U.S. Mid Cap Equity ETF (IQSM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NYLI Candriam U.S. Mid Cap Equity index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index that provides exposure to US mid-cap stocks that meet environmental, social, and corporate governance criteria. IQSM was launched on Oct 25, 2022 and is issued by NYLIM.
